meta.name: Sabboura · Chalkboard
references: Described style, no image reference: the classroom blackboard (سبّورة) of a GCC or Egyptian secondary school
Ruqʿah: the everyday handwriting script Arab teachers write on the board
Kept from Aurora (docs/brand/aurora-dna.json): layout, spacing, radii, motion timing, the two 3D heroes
meta.audience: Arabic-speaking secondary students (grades 10-12) across the GCC and Egypt, the parents who pay, and the teachers who sell
meta.notes: Colours are chosen, not measured (no reference image), so there is no measured_palette and no verify step. Contrast ratios are WCAG 2.x and listed in DESIGN.md §0.

surface.usage: Warm exercise-book paper for every page; white cards on it

primary.name: board green
primary.usage: Actions, links, focus ring. White on it 6.4:1

secondary.name: slate
secondary.usage: The board: home hero, closing band, student-tile stage

accent.name: yellow chalk
accent.usage: The one highlight per heading (underline), the board's primary button, what a student earned

chalk.usage: Coloured chalk: drawings on the board, the footer rule, the ride's rail. Never body text on paper

neutral.usage: Lightest to darkest. #16211D is ink on paper; #EEF1EA (chalk white) is text on the board, #A7B7AE muted text on the board

wood.usage: The board's ledge in the mark and the chalk tray; nowhere else

families.hand: Aref Ruqaa, 400/700: the Arabic wordmark, words chalked on the board, short handwritten notes. Never body text, never in app pages

spacing.density: airy on marketing, compact on app pages

layout.grid: 12 columns, asymmetric hero: copy on the start side, the board drawing on the end side

shape.borders: 1px hairline on paper; chalk-white at 25% on the board

elevation.approach: Paper on a desk: a soft two-layer shadow tinted with slate

iconography.subject_icons: Own 48-grid line icons (SubjectIcon), drawn in chalk on the ride

motion.principle: Chalk is written, never animated for its own sake: strokes draw once at the speed of a hand, then hold still

components.button_on_board: Yellow-chalk pill, slate text, a dusty glow
components.card: White paper, warm hairline, slate-tinted shadow, 24px radius
components.highlight: .marker: a hand-drawn yellow chalk underline under one word per heading

design_style.aesthetic: The classroom, quietly: a real slate board for the hero and the closing call, exercise-book paper for everything you read
design_style.visual_language: Chalk strokes with grain and uneven pressure, coloured chalk for subjects, Ruqʿah handwriting for the name. Everything else is a clean modern sans
design_style.composition: One board per page at most at the top (home, student home) and one at the end; paper between
design_style.imagery: No photos. Drawings are chalk diagrams a teacher would actually draw: axes and a parabola, a wave, a benzene ring, a right triangle
design_style.interaction_feel: Calm and tactile. Hover lifts paper 3px. The board responds to the pointer with a slight parallax, nothing more
design_style.brand_voice_in_ui: A good teacher at the board: plain, warm, exam-literate Arabic, no hype

overview.performance_tier: mid-range Android first: capped DPR, paused off-screen, still frame under reduced motion

background_effects.description: The board: slate gradient lighter at the centre, faint horizontal eraser smears and chalk dust (CSS on .stage; canvas in the hero)

particle_systems.description: Chalk dust: fine motes shed from the chalk tip while it writes, falling and fading; a few idle motes drift in the light

3d_elements.description: Home hero: the board as a lit plane with the chalk layer just in front, pointer parallax, dust in depth (src/components/three/board-scene.ts). Student home: the subject ride with a chalk rail

shader_effects.description: Not needed: chalk grain is drawn on a 2D canvas texture

scroll_effects.description: Sections rise 16px once with CSS view timelines; nothing scroll-jacked

text_effects.description: The name is chalked in Ruqʿah on the board as the last stroke of the intro, revealed in writing direction

glassmorphism_neumorphism.description: Only the sticky header keeps its blur

canvas_drawings.description: Chalk strokes: several jittered passes per segment with varying alpha, grain knocked out with destination-out specks, seeded so redraws match

visual_effects.composite_notes: Intro 4.2 s once per tab session: the chalk draws four subject diagrams, then writes سبّورة / Sabboura and underlines it; the hero copy rises at 3.2 s. Any input finishes the drawing at once.
